english.title: Driver of London hackney carriage after receiving deposit refuse to wait / account for deposit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a Hackney Carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), taken to a place at **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), who had received a deposit of **(..SPECIFY SUM..) in accordance with section 47 of the London Hackney Carriage Act 1831,

(A)_[refused to wait with that hackney carriage at the place that you were required to wait]_
(B)_[went away before the expiration of the time for which the sum so deposited was sufficient compensation without the consent of the person making such deposit]_
(C)_[permitted the hackney carriage to be driven or taken away before the expiration of the time for which the sum so deposited was sufficient compensation without the consent of the person making such deposit]_
(D)_[refused, on the final discharge of the hackney carriage, duly to account for such deposit]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 47 of the London Hackney Carriage Act 1831.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the driver of a hackney carriage who had demanded and received a deposit for being required to wait in accordance with section 47 of the London Hackney Carriage Act 1832
refused to wait with the hackney carriage at the place where you were required to wait OR went away
OR permitted the hackney carriage to be driven or taken away without the consent of the person making such deposit before the expiration of the time for which the sum so deposited was sufficient compensation OR refused to duly account for such deposit
